newsitem.title: UK: Mexico to launch 500 billion lire seven-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to launch 500 billion lire seven-year bond.

text.p: Mexico is expected to launch a 500 billion lire seven-year bond this week, a syndicate official at joint lead manager Chase said.
"A 500 billion lire seven-year bond will be launched on either Wednesday or Thursday this week," he said.
He said the expected coupon was 8.50 percent.
Mexico last tapped the lire sector in April this year with a 500 billion lire 20-year bond. The coupon pays 11.0 percent.
In January Mexico launched a 500 billion lire 10-year bond with a 9.125 percent coupon.
In November last year the country launched a 500 billion lire five-year floating rate note.
